'''2011 Bespin Regionals Brady Moore LS Coruscant: Night Club (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Pistone Loaner
* '''Username:''' brady1194
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
